# Studio scripts

Studio includes these browser builds so that it works without network access:

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | @xterm/xterm | 5.5.0 | MIT (`LICENSE.xterm`) |
| `addon-fit.js` | @xterm/addon-fit | 0.10.0 | MIT (`LICENSE.addon-fit`) |
| `marked.umd.js` | marked | 18.1.0 | MIT (`LICENSE.marked`) |
| `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs` | pdfjs-dist | 6.4.299 | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.pdfjs`) |
| `highlight.min.js` | highlight.js | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.highlight.js`), the viewer's own build |

The files come from the packages' npm distributions, without their source maps.
